The Japan 10 · No filler

Ten places. Ten completely different Japans.

Not a mathematical verdict: an editor’s balanced first-trip shortlist, chosen for contrast, cultural depth and the memory each place leaves behind.

01

Tokyo

For velocity: neighbourhoods that change personality every few train stops.

02

Kyoto

For accumulated time: temples, craft and early-morning stillness.

03

Fuji Five Lakes

For the icon in context: reflection, worship and volcanic geography.

04

Naoshima & Setouchi

For art in landscape: islands where architecture changes your pace.

05

Hiroshima & Miyajima

For reflection and renewal, separated by a short journey across water.

06

Kanazawa

For craft, gardens and a calmer alternative to the golden route.

07

Yakushima

For ancient forest and a ferry-or-flight shift into another climate.

08

Tohoku

For summer festivals, winter landscapes and journeys beyond the obvious.

09

Beppu & Yufuin

For the culture of hot water, from steam-filled streets to quiet baths.

10

Okinawa

For island histories, subtropical nature and a culture distinct from the mainland.
